blocks.text: [[周师傅|Zhōu shīfu|Master Zhou]] says it, then checks the bike shed one more time anyway, as if the cat might be hiding behind his words. By noon you have searched every stairwell in the [[小区|xiǎoqū|housing compound]] twice. Your knees ache. Your phone holds forty [[照片|zhàopiàn|photos]] of empty corners. Somewhere a pressure cooker whistles, and all of Chengdu smells of chilli oil and lunch. [[猫不见了。|Māo bú jiàn le.|The cat is gone.]] You keep saying it in your head, as if that will make it less true.

He marches you [[楼下|lóuxià|downstairs]] and out to the gate, to [[刘老板|Liú lǎobǎn|Boss Liu]]'s noodle shop, where the steam hits your face like a warm towel. Boss Liu is reaching for a bowl before you even sit down. On the counter sits a little dish of plain chicken. Today, nobody has come for it.

blocks.p: Mǎxiū, yào là de ma? Jǐ liǎng?

blocks.h: 哎呀，吃了没有？没吃！刘老板，二两！
blocks.p: Āiyā, chī le méiyǒu? Méi chī! Liú lǎobǎn, èr liǎng!
blocks.e: Aiya, have you eaten? No you haven't! Boss Liu, two liang!

blocks.text: [[张阿姨|Zhāng āyí|Auntie Zhang]] sweeps in, orders for you, and sits down hard. Then the door swings again and [[晓雨|Xiǎoyǔ|Xiaoyu]] appears, still in her [[宠物店|chǒngwùdiàn|pet shop]] apron, a bag of [[猫粮|māoliáng|cat food]] under one arm, just in case. News travels fast between [[邻居|línjū|neighbours]]. You strongly suspect Master Zhou of making phone calls. Xiaoyu scrolls through your photos until she finds the best one: a round white blob on your doormat, glaring at the camera like you owe it rent.

blocks.h: 我们打印照片。打印，你懂吗？
blocks.p: Wǒmen dǎyìn zhàopiàn. Dǎyìn, nǐ dǒng ma?
blocks.e: Let's print the photo. Print, do you get it?

blocks.text: She mimes a machine spitting out paper. Boss Liu slaps the counter: a [[寻猫启事|xún māo qǐshì|lost-cat notice]]! Ten minutes later, full of [[面|miàn|noodles]] and slightly on fire from the [[辣|là|spicy]] oil you definitely did not ask for, you are inside the tiny [[打印店|dǎyìndiàn|print shop]] across the road, squeezed between a student binding a thesis and a [[奶奶|nǎinai|grandma]] copying her ID card. The owner wipes his glasses and holds out his hand for your phone.

He studies the cat for a long moment. [[你在哪儿？|Nǐ zài nǎr?|Where are you?]] you ask the screen silently. Then he types fast, and the printer behind him wakes with a groan, like it has also been looking for something all morning.

blocks.p: Zhè zhī māo hǎokàn. Dǎyìn jǐ zhāng?

moment.prompt: Tell him you want twenty copies, and thank him.

opts.note: 张 (zhāng) is the measure word for flat things like paper and posters.
A bare number works, but add the measure word 张 (zhāng) and a 谢谢 (xièxie) to sound natural.
只 (zhī) counts animals, so you just said twenty cats; paper takes 张 (zhāng).
r: Èrshí zhī māo? Nǐ yǒu èrshí zhī?

summary: At midday Master Zhou drags you to Boss Liu's for lunch, where Auntie Zhang and Xiaoyu join and Xiaoyu suggests printing lost-cat posters from your doormat photo; at the print shop the owner asks how many copies you want.
